cohort: 68 term newborns (34 SGA and 34 AGA) born between December 1-30, 2015 at Fatih University Hospital
finding: Cord blood irisin levels were significantly lower in the SGA group compared to the AGA group.
mod_finding: There were no statistically significant differences in mode of delivery between small for gestational age (SGA) and appropriate for gestational age (AGA) infants.
birth_weight: SGA and AGA (based on Lubchenco scale)
